name: Ordinary Human Soldier — Level-3-equivalent non-Archetype benchmark

identity.focus_feature_notes: No Archetype, no Focus, no Prepared techniques, no Universal Veil invocations and no independent magical actions. B06 local provisional non-Archetype AP/regen defaults are explained by its design record; 'benchmark_level' is a calibration scale, not NPC character progression.

physiology_notes: Ordinary living human; physical HP/Vigor resource rules apply at benchmark level 3.
No independent Veil invocation, regardless of Veil Affinity/Control scores; personal VP pool is 0 in this non-Archetype benchmark.
behavior_notes: Disciplined shield-and-sword defender is one possible profession, not an archetypal personality or cultural template.
Can elect ordinary Guard, Dodge, Take Hit or authorized mundane actions; no free combat Talents.

defenses.resistance_notes: Ordinary mortal. No special resistance, magic immunity, species defenses, toxin immunity or added Armor stacking. Shield Guard qualifies against normal projectiles under authored shield restrictions.

start_states.condition: Sword in dominant hand, shield in other hand; brigandine worn; full HP/Vigor; no magical item effects or previously readied action. Applies only if encounter begins uninjured and properly equipped.

attack_profiles.name: Ordinary human soldier sword thrust
attack_profiles.weapon_or_source: One-handed sword, held opposite a shield; no magical item or channel

primary_hp_packet.source: Canonical sword: fixed3 + d6 + floor(max(Strength +2,0)/2)=1 Light contribution; 4+d6 raw Piercing HP, Penetration2

attack_profiles.critical_notes: One normal weapon Attack/defense sequence and existing natural-20 confirmation: Strong +1d4; Critical +2d4; Devastating +2d4 and separately qualified wound trigger. Extra HP dice add once to the primary Piercing packet before Armor; no poison, Fire or Vigor packet.

action_policy: Each own turn supplies 42 Turn AP at Level-3-equivalent benchmark; mundane Physical Action costs 24 AP by the proposed neutral non-Focus B06 baseline. Maximum one ordinary sword attack per turn (42/24 floor=1); a second attack costs a new 24 AP and is not affordable.

When attacking the same target during a turn, commit all current legal ordinary attacks before the first roll as one Attack Sequence; do not inspect hit results before choosing profile/defender assignments.

Any other legal General Tempo action also costs the existing canonical 24 AP. Full Action consumes all 42 Turn AP if wholly available; no Projection Actions or personally invoked Veil techniques are legal.
Use standard 12 MP movement and ordinary movement limits. No mounted, Reach, special maneuver, multiattack, bonus off-hand strike or automatic magic assumed.

Use ordinary once-per-own-turn regeneration throughput max(Vitality,0)+0=2, paying 1 Vigor per HP or Repair Progress if eligible. This +0 NPC Focus-rate substitute is a narrow B06 benchmark proposal, not a universal class formula.
defense_policy: At Round Begin refresh base Physical Tempo1 Guard plus Shield1 =2 Guards, reset Dodge Pressure and one Reaction. Sword Guard Defense16; Shield Guard Defense18. Shield is the declared default Guard instrument if it is still legally equipped.
First Dodge Defense13; later Dodges this round subtract 2 further pressure per previous chosen Dodge. Guard and Take Hit do not accrue Dodge Pressure.
Guard, Dodge or Take Hit must be assigned against each attack in a declared sequence before any corresponding attack rolls. Ordinary shield may Guard legal projectiles; sword alone normally cannot.
Reaction remains one per round, but this fixture has no authored Reaction-only talent/spell granting additional effects.
scenario_constraints: All nine abilities are explicitly specified, but this is an NPC template, not proof ordinary humans are subject to full player character 28-point buy, Talent schedules or Archetype progression.
Raw sword hit damage = 3+d6+floor(max(STR2,0)/2)=4+d6 Piercing HP, Pen2; target's effective Armor=max(target Armor−2,0), subtract once. No additional damage packets.
Sword Attack=d20 + STR2 + AGI2 + directly invested One-Handed Swords Training2 = d20+6. Ordinary weapon criticals obey one confirmation and one primary damage dice addition.
Sword Guard=10+STR2+AGI2+Training2=16; shield Guard=16+2 equipment bonus=18; shield grants +1 Guard capacity to base1.
Brigandine Armor5 caps positive AGI Dodge at +2; Dodge=10+2+AWA1=13; Initiative bonus AGI2+AWA1=+3.
No ability to activate magic merely because Veil Affinity and Veil Control are 0 instead of negative. All VP ledgers are 0; nonexistent purchased magical equipment never grants spells.
Non-Focus Physical Action24 and +0 Focus-rate regeneration are proposed B06 NPC baselines for review, not yet promoted canonical general rules.

formula_checks: Ability scores STR2(5), AGI2(5), PRE0(2), INT0(2), AWA1(3), PRES0(2), VIT2(5), VA0(2), VC0(2) total28; NPCs need not universally use player point-buy.
Level-3-equivalent Turn AP=min(120,30+6*(3−1))=42; non-Focus Physical24 is separately proposed benchmark cost, derived Physical Tempo=floor(42/24)=1.
Non-Focus baseline no Projection Action, maxVP0; VP sum 0+0+0=0. No spell or Universal Veil eligibility.
HP=10+VIT2=12; Vigor=(10+VIT2)*3=36. Regeneration throughput=max(VIT2,0)+0 non-Focus benchmark rate=2, one Vigor per HP/Repair Progress.
One-Handed Sword Training2; sword Attack +2 STR +2 AGI +2 Training=+6; raw Piercing 3+d6+Light contribution1 =4+d6, Pen2.
Sword Guard 10+STR2+AGI2+Training2=16; Shield Guard16+equipment bonus2=18. Physical Tempo1 plus shield +1 Guard capacity =>2.
Brigandine Armor5 Agility cap+2; Dodge Defense10+2+Awareness1=13; Initiative +3; one Reaction; Movement12MP.
Ordinary initial equipment reference cost 95+22+16+8=141sp, within optional 150sp character-creation comparison budget; NPC gear is not universally required to obey player starting wealth.
General actions 24 AP, one Physical24 -> 18 AP left; cannot pay second 24 AP attack, one current Attack Sequence per target.
known_exclusions: Not a player-Archetype build; no Focus, Pillar, spells, Universal Inspection/Blink, Preparation, Exaltation, Personal VP or innate supernatural talents.

Standard B06 neutral non-Focus action price and regeneration rate are proposed design baselines, not globally locked canonical NPC rules; review before treating as a tested and approved encounter opponent.
No automatic grant of Talent, Weapon Refinement, special Reaction, shield Intervene, armor stacking, poison, magical equipment or biological immunity.
No extra attacks from shield, natural weapons, supernatural sources or a supposed 'standard NPC bonus'.
Not a source of encounter difficulty/cr rating or statistical balance by itself; full opposed B06 encounters remain open.
validation.certification_status: B06-EN-02 executable benchmark fixture with narrowly proposed NPC-specific tempo and regeneration baseline, pending Codex review and opposed fight verification. Neither a certified Focus build nor globally canonical NPC rules.
